scope: All 108 names: the text was compared name by name with the page images of the TTD book (pp. 52–54), and every meaning was read against its name. There are no word-by-word glosses on this page (the meanings are per name). The range-number flags are the block labels. kālanābhāya and mahārāvaṇa- are the print's readings, kept as SOURCES §12.2 says.

items.issue: Small departures from the print: -sampattipradāyakāya (print -sampatpradāyakāya), kesarīsutāya (print kesari-), rudravīryasambhavāya (print -samudbhavāya).
Names 60 and 61 stood as laṅkiṇībhañjanāya, śrīmate; the print has śrīmate first.
Name 71, rāmacūḍāmaṇipradāya, was “bringer of Rāma's crest-jewel”; the jewel is Sītā's, given to Rāma. Name 91 was “the monkey of the monkeys of Hari”.
items.change: Now “who gave Rāma the crest-jewel (Sītā's token)” and “the monkey among Hari's monkeys”.

items.issue: The print holds 107 names (its numbering jumps from 78 to 80). The page's 88th name, vāgmine, is not in the print, and SOURCES said this list was already 108.
items.change: SOURCES §12.2 and the page note now say that vāgmine is supplied from the usual list.

items.issue: vāgmine (name 88) is not in the TTD print; it stands between śucaye and dṛḍhavratāya in the usual list and was supplied to reach 108. The page note now says so.
options: A. Keep vāgmine, with the note (as was done with prāṇāya in the Subrahmaṇya list).
B. Remove it and let the page show the print's 107 names.
